text: Members will continue their work planning process. Staff from Toronto Public Health and Social Development, Finance and Administration will present on their work and its impact on 2SLGBTQ+ communities, for consideration by the Committee.

The Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee: 1. Requested the Director, Equity and Human Rights, People and Equity to develop a list of 3 priority issues based on the Committee's discussion, and report back to the next Committee meeting on January 23, 2025.
